newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate eases, baht weaker late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate eases, baht weaker late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was down to 7.00-7.25 percent in late trade on Wednesday from 8.00 percent earlier and 7.50-7.75 percent late on Tuesday on higher liquidity, dealers said.
"The liquidity was higher in the afternoon as some banks offered their surplus funds into the market," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht weakened to 25.285-25.288 to the dollar late from 25.25.280-25.285 earlier on dollar's strength abroad, dealers said.
"The dollar/baht trade was in line with the U.S. unit's movement abroad which strenghtened sharply against the yen today," said one currency dealer.
The one-month swap premium declined to 5.75/6.25 satangs late from 6.00/6.75 in early morning.
The mid-rate was fixed unchanged at 25.27 against the dollar. -- Tang Nguyen (662) 252-9950
